title: People Partner, Specialist I
description:
The People Partner, Specialist I role is responsible for responding  

to advanced and complex inquiries from employees, executing People \& Culture  

transactions and data reporting using Workday and other systems. The role includes  

handling elevated and escalated requests, updating employee data and assisting  

employees directly by performing consultative actions or through third\-party vendors. This  

role requires great attention to detail and an appetite for constantly improving People \&  

Culture system, processes, and reports.  

The difference between Specialist I and II reflects increasing depth, breadth, and  

impact—progressing from executing complex transactions and resolving advanced  

inquiries to owning highly complex or escalated work, operating as a trusted partner, and  

leading improvements in systems, processes, and data quality.  

4  

Top 3 Core Competencies:  

* Customer\-Centric Service \& Advisory
* Operational Excellence \& Data Accuracy (Workday Expertise)
* Continuous Improvement \& Problem Solving


About the Role: What You'll Do  

* Provide excellent customer service in response to elevated and complex P\&C


inquiries from employees, P\&C business partners, and managers via multiple intake  

methods such as email, chat, phone, or ticketing systems  

* Handle inquiries with accuracy and speed by using knowledge guides and resources


found in multiple HR systems  

* Apply a case tool to record all inquiries, customer details, case information, and


updates. Communicate resolutions to the requester or raise more complex issues  

to the right team.  

* Carry out employee data updates directly, including bulk EIB imports into the


Workday system, and offer validation for business process data mapping  

* Handle critical issues from Tier 1 and apply the case tool to document inquiries,


customer information, case data, updates, and communicate resolutions to the  

requester.  

* Complete People \& Culture transactions and data reporting using Workday and


other systems  

* Handle elevated and advanced requests, updating employee data, and assisting


employees directly by performing consultative actions or through third\-party  

vendors  

* Maintain keen attention to detail and a drive for ongoing improvement of People \&


Culture systems, processes, and reports  

* Support your assigned region, working within the relevant shift pattern and hours to


provide support to your stakeholders accordingly.  

What We're Looking For  

* 2\+ years of experience operating within a P\&C Tier 1 customer care environment
* Acute knowledge of local benefits, talent acquisition, and Workday data


maintenance processes and policies  

* Verified experience in managing detailed issues effectively and swiftly
* Outstanding customer service skills and ability to handle advanced requests


5  

* Experience handling large\-scale EIB loads and verifying business process data


mapping in Workday  

* Strong advisory skills and ability to assist employees directly or through third\-party


vendors  

* Careful focus and a strong dedication to advancing People \& Culture systems and


processes  

* Strong communication abilities and capacity to collaborate effectively within a


group  

* Ability to apply multiple HR systems and case tools effectively
*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI\-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================


We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay\-for\-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.  

  



Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.  

  



Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Senior Lead - HR Systems Admin
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Sr. HR Systems Administrator to join our Global HR Systems team. In this role, you will provide technical expertise and oversight for Workday, Cornerstone LMS, HR ServiceNow, and other HR Systems. Your primary responsibilities will include maintaining and enhancing Workday modules and other HR Systems, consulting with business stakeholders to identify requirements, designing and implementing solutions, and providing functional and systematic support for complex system issues. You will focus on continuous improvement of system processes to drive efficiencies, reduce risk and support a superior employee experience. This will be an Individual contributor role.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Product Management and Expertise**: Serve as the Product Manager and subject matter expert for key Workday modules. Partner with HR Systems Leadership, HR Centers of Excellence, and Technology teams to develop a common roadmap for continuous system improvements in support of ongoing business needs.
* **System Maintenance and Enhancement**: Maintain, monitor, and enhance the technical and functional aspects of Workday and other HR Systems as needed. This includes managing integration points with vendors or other internal systems.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration**: Partner with HR Systems leadership, HR COE, and other stakeholders to review and prioritize system enhancement requests. Identify and clarify business requirements, create functional specifications, and configure business processes. Consult with partners to align on the best solutions to meet requirements. Create and execute test scenarios to ensure successful implementation of new functionality. Collaborate with the business and Technology teams to review and test applicable system integrations and functionality.
* **Issue Resolution and Risk Management**: Troubleshoot issues using technical expertise and propose creative system solutions to solve complex system issues quickly. Proactively evaluate potential risks and issues to identify opportunities or gaps, create solutions, and lead the implementation of changes to improve system performance. Stay up to date on HR System releases, fixes, and best practices.
* **Training and Mentorship**: Provide coaching to other HR Systems team members in specific areas of expertise through knowledge sharing and mentorship. Partner with internal HR COE teams to communicate changes for updates and releases to ensure a superior user experience.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5\+ years of Workday system configuration experience in at least 2 modules (HCM, Payroll, Benefits, etc.).
* 4\+ years in core HR processes (e.g., payroll, tax, benefits, recruiting).
* Strong consultative skills; proven ability to translate business needs into HR system design and configuration. Experience with test case development and execution.
* Success in implementing system enhancements that deliver measurable results.
* Strong analytical skills with high accuracy in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent documentation skills for clear configuration notes and test cases.
* Strong critical thinking and situational decision\-making abilities.
* Effective both independently and in team settings within dynamic environments.
* Post\-implementation support experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with HR systems like HR ServiceNow, Cornerstone, STAR Compliance, or other cloud\-based/SaaS platforms.
* Workday Pro Certification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for interacting with leaders and partners.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects in various roles.

**In\-Office Collaboration**


We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: Personal Assistant to Director
description:
Role Overview

The Personal Assistant to the CEO will provide comprehensive administrative, operational and coordination support to the Chief Executive Officer. The role requires excellent organisation, discretion, communication and follow\-through.

The successful candidate will manage the CEO’s schedule, meetings, correspondence, travel and documentation while coordinating with senior management, employees, clients, investors, regulators and other external stakeholders.

Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive Support

* Manage the CEO’s calendar, appointments and daily schedule.
* Prioritise meetings and commitments according to business requirements.
* Prepare daily and weekly schedules, reminders and briefing notes.
* Screen incoming calls, correspondence and meeting requests.
* Draft emails, letters, presentations, reports and other business documents.
* Maintain an organised record of important documents and communications.
* Handle confidential business and personal information with complete discretion.

Meeting Coordination

* Schedule internal and external meetings for the CEO.
* Prepare agendas, presentations and supporting documents.
* Record minutes of meetings and circulate action points.
* Track decisions, deadlines and pending deliverables.
* Follow up with department heads and other stakeholders on behalf of the CEO.
* Ensure that the CEO receives relevant documents before each meeting.

Travel and Event Management

* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements.
* Prepare itineraries and arrange flights, hotels, local transport and meetings.
* Maintain travel records and assist with expense documentation.
* Coordinate the CEO’s participation in conferences, investor meetings and company events.
* Support arrangements for board meetings and senior\-management reviews.

Management Coordination

* Act as a professional point of contact between the CEO and internal departments.
* Coordinate with HR, finance, operations, compliance, legal, credit, collections and business teams.
* Monitor the status of projects and assignments identified by the CEO.
* Compile departmental updates into concise management summaries.
* Escalate delays, unresolved matters and significant issues promptly.
* Assist the CEO with special projects and strategic initiatives.

Stakeholder Communication

* Communicate professionally with clients, investors, lenders, directors, consultants and business partners.
* Coordinate meetings and information requests involving external stakeholders.
* Maintain updated stakeholder and contact records.
* Ensure that sensitive communications are handled through appropriate channels.
* Represent the CEO’s office with professionalism and courtesy.

Documentation and Compliance Support

* Maintain confidential records, agreements, reports and board\-related documents.
* Coordinate signatures, approvals and document circulation.
* Support the preparation and organisation of regulatory, audit and compliance documentation.
* Maintain structured physical and electronic filing systems.
* Ensure that documents are stored and shared in accordance with company policy.
* Avoid disclosing customer, employee, transaction or company information without proper authorisation.

Administrative Responsibilities

* Process and track bills, reimbursements and expenses relating to the CEO’s office.
* Maintain office supplies and administrative requirements for the executive office.
* Assist in preparing management reports and presentations.
* Coordinate visitors and business appointments.
* Perform other reasonable responsibilities assigned by the CEO.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, Finance or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification or professional certification in administration or management would be beneficial.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and online meeting platforms.
* Strong command of written and spoken English.
* Knowledge of Hindi or relevant regional languages would be an advantage.

Experience

* Approximately 3–7 years of experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative position.
* Previous experience supporting a CEO, Managing Director, founder or senior executive is preferred.
* Experience in an NBFC, bank, microfinance institution, fintech company or financial\-services organisation would be advantageous.
* Experience coordinating with senior stakeholders and handling confidential information is essential.

Key Skills

* Calendar and time management
* Business correspondence and document preparation
* Meeting and travel coordination
* Follow\-up and task tracking
* Executive\-level communication
* Presentation and report preparation
* Stakeholder coordination
* Record and document management
* High attention to detail
* Ability to manage competing priorities
* Sound judgement and problem\-solving
* Confidentiality and professional integrity

Personal Attributes

* Highly organised, dependable and punctual
* Discreet and trustworthy
* Calm under pressure
* Proactive and solution\-oriented
* Professional in appearance and communication
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Able to anticipate the CEO’s administrative and information requirements
* Willing to work flexible hours when business requirements demand it
* Capable of maintaining appropriate professional boundaries

Key Performance Indicators

* Accuracy and organisation of the CEO’s calendar
* Timely preparation of meetings and briefing materials
* Completion and follow\-up of assigned action items
* Quality and accuracy of correspondence and reports
* Responsiveness to internal and external stakeholders
* Effectiveness of travel and event coordination
* Confidentiality and document\-control compliance
* Timely escalation of critical matters
* Overall efficiency of the CEO’s office

Application Requirements

Interested candidates may submit their updated résumé along with the following details:

* Current compensation
* Expected compensation
* Notice period
* Current location
* Relevant experience supporting senior executives

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹90,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* urgent Hiring

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
### **Executive Assistant to CEO**

  

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Executive Assistant provides executive support in a one\-on\-one working relationship. The Executive Assistant serves as the primary point of contact for internal and external constituencies on all matters involving the CEO. The Executive Assistant also serves as a liaison to the Core Committee and senior management teams; organizes and coordinates executive outreach and external relations efforts; and oversees special projects. The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a variety of situations, with strong written and verbal communication, administrative, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple priorities. The Executive Assistant will have the ability to work independently on projects, from conception to completion, and must be able to work under pressure and travel at times to handle a wide variety of activities and confidential matters with discretion.

 **Specific responsibilities:**

  

* Completes a broad variety of administrative tasks for the CEO, including managing an extremely active calendar of appointments; completing expense reports; composing and preparing correspondence that is sometimes confidential; arranging complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compiling documents for travel\-related meetings. Plans, coordinates, and ensures the CEO's schedule is followed and respected. Provides "gatekeeper" and "gateway" roles, creating win\-win situations for direct access to the CEO's time and office

  

* Communicates directly, on behalf of the CEO, with the Core Committee, Administration, HR, Operations, Branches, Zonal managers, Processing, Accounts, legal, etc.

  

* Research prioritizes, and follows up on incoming issues and concerns addressed to the CEO, including those of a sensitive or confidential nature. Determines the appropriate course of action, referral, or response.

  

* Provides a bridge for smooth communication between the CEO and internal departments; demonstrating leadership to maintain credibility, trust, \& support with senior management staff.

  

* Works closely and effectively with the CEO to keep him well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately. Acts as a "barometer," having a sense of the issues taking place in the environment and keeping the CEO updated.

  

* Provides leadership to build relationships crucial to the success of the organization, and manages a variety of projects for the CEO, some of which may have organizational impact.

  

* Completes critical aspects of deliverables with a hands\-on approach, including drafting acknowledgement letters, personal correspondence, and other tasks that facilitate the CEO's ability to effectively lead the company.

  

* Prioritizes conflicting needs; handles matters expeditiously, and proactively, and follows through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures.

 **NB:** The principal responsibilities listed above are an illustrative list and not an exhaustive list. Additional responsibilities will be added from time to time, depending on organizational requirements.

 **KEY SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Qualification**

  

* Any UG degree with relevant experience
* MBA Corporate Governance / Secretarial Course preferred

**Experience**


Minimum of 3 to 5 years’ experience in administration.

**Age**


25–30 years

**Sex**


Female/Male (Preference for Female candidates)

**Computer skills**

* Excellent MS Office, internet and emails

**Language skills**

* Good written and oral communication skills in English.
* Good email\-drafting skills in English
* **Functional skills**
* Good verbal and written communication \& presentation skills with strong business\-related knowledge
* Strong organizational skills that reflect the ability to perform and prioritize multiple tasks seamlessly with excellent attention to detail
* Very strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders, including staff, Core committee, and external partners § Expert level written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated proactive approaches to problem\-solving with strong decision\-making capability
* Emotional maturity
* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion, be adaptable to various competing demands, and demonstrate the highest level of customer/client service and response
* Demonstrated ability to achieve high\-performance goals and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment

title: AGM - HR
description:
**About Us:**

  

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

  

We build long\-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

**Note:** The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.


The Assistant General Manager (AGM) \- Talent Acquisition will lead and drive the organization's talent acquisition strategy, ensuring the timely hiring of high\-quality talent across business functions. The role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, workforce planning, employer branding, recruitment analytics, and team management capabilities.


The incumbent will partner with business leaders to build a robust talent pipeline, optimize recruitment processes, and deliver hiring outcomes aligned with organizational growth objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Talent Acquisition Strategy**

* Develop and execute talent acquisition strategies aligned with business objectives and workforce plans.
* Lead hiring initiatives across Operations, RCM, Healthcare, Technology, Corporate Functions, and Leadership positions.
* Drive workforce planning discussions with business leaders to understand current and future talent requirements.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for critical and niche skill sets.

### **Leadership \& Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Talent Acquisition Managers, Team Leads, and Recruiters.
* Establish performance metrics and drive accountability within the recruitment team.
* Foster a high\-performance and collaborative recruitment culture.
* Conduct regular reviews and capability\-building initiatives for the TA team.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a strategic talent advisor to business leaders.
* Collaborate with senior leadership on manpower planning, succession planning, and hiring strategies.
* Provide market intelligence regarding talent availability, compensation trends, and competitor hiring practices.
* Influence hiring decisions through data\-driven insights.

### **Recruitment Delivery**

* Ensure achievement of hiring targets while maintaining quality and SLA adherence.
* Monitor and improve key recruitment metrics including:Time\-to\-Fill Time\-to\-Hire Cost\-per\-Hire Offer\-to\-Join Ratio Source Effectiveness Quality of Hire
* Drive process improvements to enhance recruitment efficiency and candidate experience.

### **Employer Branding \& Talent Attraction**

* Strengthen the organization's employer brand through innovative sourcing and attraction strategies.
* Lead social media recruitment campaigns and branding initiatives.
* Build relationships with industry networks, educational institutions, and professional associations.
* Represent the organization at career fairs, industry forums, and talent events.

### **Recruitment Analytics \& Governance**

* Review recruitment dashboards and analytics to provide actionable insights.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, governance standards, and hiring processes.
* Optimize recruitment technology, ATS utilization, and automation initiatives.
* Present hiring reviews and TA performance reports to senior leadership.

**Key Deliverables**
--------------------

* Achievement of annual hiring targets.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction scores.
* Improved hiring velocity and recruitment productivity.
* Enhanced quality of hire and retention of new hires.
* Development of future talent pipelines.
* Strengthened employer brand positioning.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Additional certifications in Talent Acquisition, HR Analytics, or Leadership Development will be an advantage.

### **Experience**

* 12\-18 years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition.
* Strong exposure to large\-scale hiring and strategic workforce planning.
* Experience managing recruitment teams and senior stakeholder relationships.
* Prior experience in Healthcare, RCM, BPO, ITES, Technology, or Shared Services environment preferred.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**
-----------------------------------

### **Functional Competencies**

* Strategic Talent Acquisition
* Workforce Planning
* Leadership Hiring
* Recruitment Analytics
* Employer Branding
* Talent Mapping \& Market Intelligence
* Vendor Management
* Compensation Benchmarking

### **Behavioral Competencies**

* Executive Presence
* Strategic Thinking
* Business Acumen
* Influencing \& Negotiation
* Stakeholder Management
* Decision Making
* Problem Solving
* Change Management
* People Leadership

**Success Profile**
-------------------


The ideal candidate will be a strategic recruitment leader who can balance business priorities with talent market realities, lead large recruitment teams, build strong business partnerships, and consistently deliver exceptional hiring outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**  

**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye\-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6\-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.

It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.
